αἰνόθεν: Αἶνος — Aenus, a town on the Thracian coast; Αἰνόθεν with the suffix -θεν: ’from Aenus’
αἰνῆς: αἰνός — dread, grim, grievous; fem. gen. sg.: ’fearsome’
αἰνῶς: αἰνῶς — terribly, exceedingly; adv. from αἰνός, intensifying a verb of feeling: αἰνῶς δείδοικα ’I am terribly afraid’ · also intensifying a verb of likeness: ’terribly like’ (αἰνῶς … ἔοικεν ’is terribly like’)
αἲ: αἴ (epic = εἰ) — if, would that; particle introducing a wish + opt. (αἲ γάρ ’would that’)
αἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj., epic/dialectal by-form αἰ (used before κε)
αἴαντα: Αἴας — Ajax, the great Telamonian hero; masc. acc. sg.
αἴσιμα: αἴσιμος — fitting, right, according to what is destined; neut. acc. pl.: ’what is fitting, fitting things’
αὐτός: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. sg.: ’he himself’
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὸν: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. sg., reinforcing a pronoun: ’me myself’ (ἔμ’ αὐτὸν) · also plain personal pronoun after a preposition: ’him’ (παρ’ αὐτὸν ’beside him’) · also intensive, with the object already named by a pronoun: ’you yourself’ (σε … αὐτὸν δὲ κλαίοντα ’you yourself, weeping’) · also plain personal pronoun as direct object: ’him’ (αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’they set upon him’) · also intensive, standing for the subject of an infinitive: ’himself’ (αὐτὸν δ’ … μάχεσθαι ’and himself to fight’)
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg., intensive with the subject: ’myself, yourself, himself’
αὔτως: αὔτως — just so, idly, without more; adv.: ’merely, to no purpose’
αὖθι: αὖθι — there, on the spot, right there; adv. (cf. αὖθις)
αὖτις: αὖτις — back, again, once more; adv. (= αὖθις)
βίη: βίη — might, bodily strength, force; fem. nom. sg.
βασιλῆα: βασιλεύς — king; masc. acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic βασιλέα)
βασιλῆες: βασιλεύς — king; masc. nom. pl., epic -ῆες (= Attic -εῖς)
βιότοιο: βίοτος — life, livelihood; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
βουληφόρος: βουληφόρος — counsel-bearing, giving counsel; adj., masc. nom. sg.
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γέρων: γέρων — old man; masc. nom. sg.
γαῖα: γαῖα — earth, land; fem. nom. sg. (epic = Attic γῆ)
γαῖαν: γαῖα — earth, land; fem. acc. sg.
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γενεήν: γενεή — birth, race, lineage; fem. acc. sg., Ionic η (= Attic γενεά)
γενεῇ: γενεή — birth, lineage, descent; fem. dat. sg.: ’by birth’
γερήνιος: Γερήνιος — Gerenian, standing epithet of Nestor; masc. nom. sg.; meaning uncertain — perhaps from a place Gerenia, or linked to γέρας ’honour’
γυναῖκες: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. nom. pl.: ’women’
δ: δέ (elided δ’) — and, but · also the elided suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Ἄργος δ’ ’to Argos’)
δέ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Οὔλυμπον δέ ’to Olympus’)
δίου: Δῖον — Dium, a town of Euboea; neut. gen. sg. (Δίου)
δίῳ: δῖος — bright, noble, divine (epic epithet); masc. dat. sg.
δαναῶν: Δαναοί — the Danaans, the Greeks; masc. gen. pl.
δηϊοτῆτος: δηϊοτής — hostile fighting, combat (cf. δήϊος ’hostile’); fem. gen. sg., stem δηϊοτῆτ-
διομήδης: Διομήδης — Diomedes, king of Argos; masc. nom. sg.
δουρί: δόρυ — spear, shaft; neut. dat. sg., epic δουρί (= Attic δόρατι)
δουρὶ: δόρυ — spear; neut. dat. sg., epic δουρί (= Attic δορί)
δόμον: δόμος — house, home; masc. acc. sg.
δὲ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (οἶκον δὲ ’homeward’)
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῖος: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes (= fem. δῖα)
δῦναι: δύω — go down, sink, set; aor. inf. act. (root aorist), of the sun: ’to set’ · also ’go down into, enter’ (δῦναι δόμον Ἄϊδος εἴσω ’to go down into the house of Hades’)
δῶκε: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἔδωκε)
δῶκεν: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔδωκεν)
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also ’whether’, introducing an indirect question · εἰ δή ’if indeed, since’ · also εἰ δ’ ἄγε ’come now’, a hortatory idiom
εἰπὼν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also + acc. of respect: ’in’ (εἰς ὦπα ’in face’)
εἴ: εἰ — if, whether; accented εἴ before an enclitic (εἴ κεν, εἴ ποτε, εἴ περ)
εἴη: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 sg.: ’it might be, he might be’; potential with κεν: ’it would be’ · also in a wish after εἴθε: ’would that it were’
εἴθ: εἴθε — would that; epic wish particle + opt., elided (εἴθ’ = εἴθε)
εἴπεσκεν: εἶπον — say, speak; iterative aor. 3 sg. in -σκε(ν), epic (Attic εἶπε): ’would say, used to say’
εἴσω: εἴσω — within, inside; adv. · also adv. with a gen., as a preposition: ’into’ (Ἄϊδος εἴσω ’into (the house of) Hades’)
εἶσιν: εἶμι — go; pres. 3 sg., ν-movable (= Attic εἶσι(ν)): ’goes’
εὐαίμονος: Εὐαίμων — Euaemon, father of Eurypylus; masc. gen. sg.
εὐρύν: εὐρύς — wide, broad; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with οὐρανόν, set after its noun
εὐρύπυλος: Εὐρύπυλος — Eurypylus, son of Euaemon, leader of the men of Ormenium; masc. nom. sg.
εὐρὺ: εὐρύς — wide, broad; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’widely’ (εὐρὺ κρείων ’wide-ruling’)
εὖχος: εὖχος — boast, glory, vaunt of victory; neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’cause to boast’
θεοῖσι: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic θεοῖς)
θεοῖσιν: θεός — god; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic -οις)
θεράποντες: θεράπων — attendant, comrade-in-arms; masc. voc. pl., in address: ’servants (of Ares)’ · also masc. nom. pl., subject: ’attendants’
θεράποντι: θεράπων — attendant, squire; masc. dat. sg.
θυμὸν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (θυμὸν ὀλέσσῃ ’lose his life’)
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
θόας: Θόας — Thoas, an Aetolian leader (son of Andraemon); masc. nom. sg.
κάρτιστον: κάρτιστος — best, mightiest; epic superlative (= Attic κράτιστος); masc. acc. sg.
κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · with αἴ + subj.: ’if perhaps’ · with a relative + fut. indic.: ’who will, in that event’ · also εἰς ὅ κέ + fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κέ σ’ … ποιήσεται ’until he makes you’) · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’will’ (καί κέ τις … ἐρέει ’someone will say’) · also ὄφρά κέ + subj.: ’until’ (… κέ … ἐνείκω ’until I bring’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so … might’
καλά: καλός — beautiful, fine, good; neut. nom./acc. pl.
κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); with the subj. in purpose and general clauses · also + subj. in a temporal or conditional clause: ’whenever’, ’if’ · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’shall’ (κε μελήσεται ’will concern’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (τώ κε … ἠμύσειε ’then would collapse’) · also with an impf. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (κε … ἔπασχον ’I would have suffered’)
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); with the opt., potential: ’might, would’; with the subj. in conditions after εἰ, αἰ · also + subj. or fut. indic. in a main or relative clause: ’shall’ (’I shall take’; ’to whom I come’) · also + subj. in a general relative clause: ’whatever’ (ὅττί κεν εἴπῃς) · also with a past indic., contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἔνθά κεν … ἐτύχθη) · also with an impf. indic., past potential: ’would be’ (κεν … κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would be better’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause after εἰς ὅ: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … μάχωνται ’until they fight’) · also εἴ κεν + opt., in a condition: ’if … should’ · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὥς: ’so that … may’ · also + subj. in a temporal clause after ὅτε: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … ἵκωμαι ’whenever I come’)
κορυθαίολος: κορυθαίολος — with glancing, flashing helmet; masc. nom. sg., stock epithet of Hector
κρατερὸς: κρατερός — mighty, strong; adj., masc. nom. sg.
κρείων: κρείων — ruling, lord, sovereign; masc. nom. sg., epithet of kings (εὐρὺ κρείων ’wide-ruling’)
κυδιανείρῃ: κυδιάνειρα — bringing men glory, man-ennobling (of battle); fem. dat. sg., epic -ῃ (= Attic -ᾳ)
κυνέῃ: κυνέη — helmet, cap (properly of dog-skin); fem. dat. sg., epic (= Attic κυνῇ)
λαοὶ: λαός — people, host; masc. nom. pl. (epic; Attic λεώς, pl. λεῴ)
λυκόοργος: Λυκοῦργος — Lycurgus, son of Dryas; masc. nom. sg., uncontracted epic Λυκόοργος (= contracted Λυκοῦργος)
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μάλ: μάλα (elided μάλ’) — very, very much, by all means; adv.
μάχεσθαι: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); pres. inf. (Attic μάχεσθαι), + dat. ’fight against’ · also with ἀμφί + dat. of the cause: ’fight over’ (ἀμφ’ Ἑλένῃ … μάχεσθαι ’to fight over Helen’)
μάχης: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. gen. sg., after ἀπάνευθε · also fem. gen. sg., governed by εἰδότε: ’skilled in all (fighting)’ · also fem. gen. sg. of separation, with ἔσχοντο: ’from the fighting’ · also fem. gen. sg., object of ἀντιβολῆσαι: ’to meet (the battle)’ · also fem. gen. sg. of place, with ἐπ’ ἀριστερά: ’on the left of the battle’ · also fem. gen. sg., governed by ἀδαήμονι: ’ignorant of (battle)’ · also fem. gen. sg. of separation, with ἐξαποδίωμαι: ’out of the battle’ · also fem. gen. sg., dependent on ἔργον: ’of battle’ (ἔργον … μάχης ’work of battle’) · also fem. gen. sg., dependent on νίκην: ’victory of battle’ (μάχης νίκην)
μάχοντο: μάχομαι — fight; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐμάχοντο): ’were fighting’
μάχῃ: μάχη — battle, fight; fem. dat. sg.
μέγ: μέγας — great; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, elided (μέγ’ = μέγα): ’greatly’ · also neut. nom. sg., elided (μέγ’ = μέγα), with a noun: ’great’ (μέγ’ ἔρισμα ’a great cause of strife’) · also neut. acc. sg., elided, with a noun: ’great’ (μέγ’ εὖχος ’great cause to boast’)
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μέσον: μέσος — middle, mid-; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ἱστίον: ’the middle of the sail’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἀγκῶνα: ’the middle (of the elbow)’ (ἀγκῶνα … μέσον ’full on the elbow’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a noun: ’the middle, the space between’ (ἐς μέσον ἀμφοτέρων ’into the space between the two’)
μή: μή — not; the negative of wish, command, fear and condition (where οὐ is the negative of fact) · also ’lest’, with the subj. · also ’lest’ with the opt. (μή … δευοίατο ’lest they lack’) · also ’lest’ with a dual verb in -ετον: ’lest the two … hang back’
μακρῷ: μακρός — long, tall; masc./neut. dat. sg.
μαχόμην: μάχομαι — fight; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἐμαχόμην): ’I fought’
μεγάροισιν: μέγαρον — hall, great chamber; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
μενέλαε: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, king of Sparta; masc. voc. sg.
μενέλαος: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, king of Sparta, brother of Agamemnon; masc. nom. sg.
μετέειπε: μετεῖπον — speak among, address; aor. 3 sg., epic uncontracted, with the vowel doubled (= Attic μετεῖπε)
μετέειπεν: μετεῖπον — speak among, address a group (poetic aor., defective); aor. 3 sg.: ’spoke among them’
μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; + dat./acc./gen. · also an adverb, ’among them’, or a preverb in tmesis
μηδ: μηδέ — and not, nor; conj., elided (μηδ’ = μηδέ), with an imperative: ’and do not’ · also with an optative of wish: ’and let … not’ (μηδ’ ἔτι … εἴην ’and may I no longer be’) · also with a hortatory subj.: ’and let us not’ (μηδ’ … ἀμβαλλώμεθα ’and let us not put off’)
μηριόνης: Μηριόνης — Meriones, Idomeneus’ Cretan comrade; masc. nom. sg.
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of possession or interest: ’my’ (μοι ἵπποι ’my horses’)
μυρμιδόνων: Μυρμιδόνες — the Myrmidons, Achilles’ people; masc. gen. pl.
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μὴ: μή — not; negative in wishes, prohibitions and purpose clauses (’lest, that not’) · also in a conditional clause + subj.: ’if not’ · also in a conditional clause + opt.: εἰ μὴ … μνησαίαθ’ ’unless … were to call to mind’ · also εἰ μὴ with an aor. indic., past unreal condition: ’had not’ (εἰ μὴ … ἐξήγγειλεν ’had not … told’)
μῶλον: μῶλος — toil of battle, struggle; masc. acc. sg. (μῶλον Ἄρηος ’the toil of Ares’)
νέστωρ: Νέστωρ — Nestor, king of Pylos; masc. nom. sg.
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him, her’ · also ὁ, ἡ, τό, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἱ ἄριστοι ’the best men’)
οἳ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. pl., ’who’
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also demonstrative, with γε: ’they’ (οἵ γ’ ἀθέριζον) · also encl. dat. sg. οἱ, accented before a following enclitic: ’to him’ (δέ οἵ ἐστ’ ’and his … is’)
οὐ: οὐ — not; neg. adv. · also in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ (οὐ γὰρ δὴ … ἐβούλευσας; ’did you not devise …?’)
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐκέτ: οὐκέτι — no longer; adv., elided (οὐκέτ’ = οὐκέτι)
οὐρανὸν: οὐρανός — heaven, sky; masc. acc. sg.
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὔδει: οὖδας — ground, floor (Attic ἔδαφος); neut. dat. sg. οὔδει (also οὔδεϊ): ’on the floor’
οὕνεκ: οὕνεκα — because, for that reason; conj., elided (οὕνεκ’ = οὕνεκα)
οὗτος: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. sg.: ’this one’
πάντας: πᾶς — all, every; masc. acc. pl.
πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πένθος: πένθος — grief, sorrow; neut. nom. sg.
παναχαιῶν: Πανάχαιοι — all the Achaeans, i.e. the whole Greek host; masc. gen. pl.
παρειπών: παρεῖπον (aor. of παραφημί) — talk over, win over with words; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having persuaded’
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
πολέμοιο: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
πολεμίζειν: πολεμίζω — make war, fight; pres. inf.: πόλεμον πολεμίζειν ’to wage war’
πολλά: πολύς — much, many; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’many’ · also adverbial: ’much’
πολλὸν: πολύς — much; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, epic (= Attic πολύ): ’by far’
πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’much, by far’
ποτέ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; encl. adv.
προκαλίζετο: προκαλίζομαι — challenge, call out (+ acc. of those challenged, + inf.); impf. 3 sg. mid.
προφρονέως: προφρονέως — readily, willingly, eagerly; adv. of πρόφρων (-έως = Attic -όνως)
πρόμον: πρόμος — foremost fighter, champion; masc. acc. sg.
πρόμος: πρόμος — foremost fighter, champion; masc. nom. sg.
πρὶν: πρίν — before, sooner; adv./conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
πρῶτος: πρῶτος — first; masc. nom. sg., predicative: ’first (to do it)’
πόποι: πόποι — in ὦ πόποι, exclamation of surprise or displeasure: ’ah! alas!’; origin unknown
πόρε: πόρω (defective, aor. only) — furnish, grant, give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’gave’ · also aor. imper. 2 sg. (same form): τοῦτο πόρε ’give this!’
πὰρ: παρά (apocope πάρ, grave before another word) — beside, alongside; prep. + dat.: ’beside’ · also prep. + acc., ’beside’ (πὰρ ποταμὸν ’beside the river’) · also prep. + gen., ’from beside’ (πὰρ Διὸς ’from Zeus’) · also adverb, ’beside him’ · also adverb, no case: ’beside, alongside’ (πὰρ δὲ … ἕστασαν ’and beside … stood’)
σέο: σύ — you (sg.); gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic σοῦ), gen. of comparison: ’than you’ · also possessive gen.: ’your’ · also gen. sg. after εἵνεκα: ’because of you’
σεῦ: σύ — you; gen. sg., epic σεῦ (= Attic σοῦ)
σιωπῇ: σιωπή — silence; fem. dat. sg., dative of manner: ’in silence’
στεναχίζετο: στεναχίζω — groan, sigh, resound with groaning; impf. 3 sg. mid./pass.
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’
τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl., ’those things’; accented before an enclitic · also relative, neut. nom. pl.: ’which’ (τά τ’ αἰδῶ ἀμφικαλύπτει ’which cover the shame’) · also neut. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τά τε δῶρ’ Ἀφροδίτης ’and the gifts of Aphrodite’) · also relative, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’ (τά οἵ ποτε … πόρε ’which he once gave him’)
τάδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also neut. acc. pl. adverbially: ’in this way’ (τάδε μαίνεται ’rages like this’) · also neut. acc. pl. with a noun: ’this’ (τάδε τόξα ’this bow’)
τάχ: τάχα — soon, quickly, perhaps; adv., elided (τάχ’ = τάχα)
τί: τίς, τι — anyone, anything; indefinite enclitic, accented τί before an enclitic; neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’at all, in any way’ · also interrogative τίς, τί: ’what? why?’ (τί κλαίεις ’why are you weeping?’)
ταύτης: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; fem. gen. sg., agreeing with γενεῆς: ’of this’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τεύχε: τεῦχος — armour, gear (pl. τεύχεα); neut. nom. pl., elided (τεύχε’ = τεύχεα)
τεύχεα: τεῦχος — armor, gear; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic τεύχη)
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’)
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τούτῳ: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; masc. dat. sg.
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative, masc. acc. pl.: ’whom’
τοῖς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl.: ’to the others’ (τοῖς ἄλλοις) · also masc. dat. pl., ’to them’ (τοῖς … μύθων ἦρχε ’led the talk before them’)
τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. gen. sg., ’of him, him’ · also relative, ’whose’ · also with a noun, ’that’ (τοῦ βασιλῆος ’that king’) · also neut. gen. sg., ’of it’, after ἐκ: ’out of it’ (the chariot-board)
τυδέος: Τυδεύς — Tydeus, father of Diomedes; masc. gen. sg. (Τυδέος υἱός ’son of Tydeus’, periphrasis for Diomedes)
τυδεΐδης: Τυδεΐδης — son of Tydeus, i.e. Diomedes; masc. nom. sg. (patronymic)
τόν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’, with γε ’him at least’ · also relative, ’whom, which’ (τόν ῥ’ … ἧκε ’which he sent’) · also masc. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’that (lord)’
τώ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, they two’ (τώ γε) · also dual relative: ’the two who’ (τώ οἱ ἔσαν κήρυκε ’the two who were his heralds’) · also adverb (= Attic τῷ), ’therefore, so’ · also dual acc. relative: ’whom (the two)’ (τώ μοι … γείνατο ’whom … bore for me’)
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl. · τὰ πρῶτα ’at first’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’ · also neut. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own tasks’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’) · also instrumental, ’with it’ (τῷ … τύψε ’struck with it’) · also relative, instrumental: ’with which’ · also causal/instrumental, ’by it’ (τῷ τείρετο ’was worn by it’) · also with ἅμα, of company: ’with him’ (τῷ … ἅμ’ ’along with him’)
φάλαγγας: φάλαγξ — line of battle, battle-line, phalanx; fem. acc. pl.
φάνη: φαίνω — show; aor. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐφάνη): ’appeared’
φέρτερος: φέρτερος — stronger, better; comparative of ἀγαθός, masc. nom. sg., predicate
φίλας: φίλος — dear, own; fem. acc. pl.
φίλῳ: φίλος — dear, beloved, one’s own; adj., masc. dat. sg.
φορῆναι: φορέω — carry, bear; pres. inf., epic -ῆναι (= Attic φορεῖν)
φρένας: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. acc. pl.
φωνήσας: φωνέω — utter, raise one’s voice; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having raised his voice’
φωτὶ: φώς — man, mortal; masc. dat. sg., after ἐοικώς: ’(like) a man’
φὼς: φώς — man; masc. nom. sg. (epic, φωτός in the gen.)
χάλκεος: χάλκεος — of bronze, bronze; adj., masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic χαλκοῦς)
χειρὸς: χείρ — hand; fem. gen. sg.; χειρὸς ἑλόντε ’taking by the hand’ (gen. of the part seized) · also fem. gen. sg. of separation, with ἀπό in tmesis: ’from the hand’ (ἀπ’ … χειρὸς ὀμόργνυ)
χρὴ: χρή — it is necessary, one must; impersonal verb + acc. and inf.
ἀγαμέμνων: Ἀγαμέμνων — Agamemnon, king of Mycenae, leader of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἀγλαὸς: ἀγλαός — splendid, radiant; masc. nom. sg.
ἀγορητής: ἀγορητής — speaker, orator; masc. nom. sg.
ἀδελφειοῦ: ἀδελφειός — brother (by-form of ἀδελφός); masc. gen. sg., epic -οῦ (= Attic ἀδελφοῦ)
ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
ἀθανάτοισι: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ἀθηναίη: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. nom. sg., epic full form (= Ἀθήνη) · also fem. voc. sg., in address
ἀκὴν: ἀκήν — silent, in silence; adv. (frozen acc. of ἀκή), predicative: ’still, silent’
ἀλκήν: ἀλκή — defensive strength, might, valour; fem. acc. sg., also of respect: ’in might’
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀμείνων: ἀμείνων — better, stronger; masc. nom. sg., comparative of ἀγαθός
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ … ἴαχε = ἀμφίαχε ’roared around’) · also prep. + acc., ’around’ (ἀμφὶ ῥέεθρα ’around the streams’) · also prep. + dat. or φιν-case, ’about’ (ἀμφὶ στήθεσφιν ’about the chest’)
ἀνέσταν: ἀνίστημι — stand up, rise; aor. 3 pl., root aorist, intrans. (= Attic ἀνέστησαν)
ἀνέσχον: ἀνέχω — hold up, raise; aor. 3 pl. act. (also 1 sg.): ’they held up’
ἀνδρειφόντῃ: ἀνδρειφόντης — man-slaying, killer of men; masc. dat. sg., epithet of Enyalius
ἀντίον: ἀντίον — opposite, face to face; adv. or prep. + gen.: ’in opposition to, to the face of’
ἀντίος: ἀντίος — opposite, facing, to meet (+ gen.); masc. nom. sg. · also + dat., ’to meet, against’ (τῇ δ’ ἀντίος ’to meet her’)
ἀντιβολῆσαι: ἀντιβολέω — meet, encounter (+ gen.); aor. inf. act.: ’to meet’
ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; + acc. (ἀνὰ στρατόν ’throughout the army’) · + dat., ’upon’ (ἀνὰ σκήπτρῳ ’upon a sceptre’) · also adv./preverb in tmesis: ’up, aboard’ (ἀνὰ … εἷσεν ’set aboard’) · also + acc. in ἀνὰ στόμ’ ἔχων ’having on your lips, going on about’
ἀνῆκε: ἀνίημι — send up, rouse, set on; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’set on, urged on’
ἀπ: ἀπό (elided ἀπ’) — from, away from; prep. + gen. · also a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀπ’ … ὀμόργνυ = ἀπομόργνυ ’wiped off’)
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)
ἀρίστους: ἀγαθός — good; superlative ἄριστος, masc. acc. pl.: ’the best’
ἀργείοισιν: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ἀργείων: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀρηϊθόοιο: Ἀρηΐθοος — Areithous (name); masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἀριστῆες: ἀριστεύς — best man, chief; masc. nom. pl., epic -ῆες (= Attic -εῖς)
ἀρκάδες: Ἀρκάς — Arcadian; adj. of two endings, masc. nom. pl.
ἀτάλαντος: ἀτάλαντος — equal (in weight), a match for; adj., masc. nom. sg., + dat.: ’equal to’
ἀτρεΐδαο: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus, i.e. Agamemnon; gen. sg., epic (-αο = Attic -ου) · also son of Atreus, i.e. Menelaus; masc. gen. sg.
ἀτρεΐδης: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
ἀχαιΐδα: Ἀχαιΐς — Achaean; adj. of land, fem. acc. sg. · also used as a noun: ’Achaea’, the Achaean land (Ἀχαιΐδα καλλιγύναικα ’Achaea of the fair women’)
ἀχαιΐδες: Ἀχαιΐς — Achaean woman; fem. nom./voc. pl., of men as an insult: ’Achaean women!’
ἀχαιοί: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιούς: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀχιλεὺς: Ἀχιλλεύς — Achilles, son of Peleus; masc. nom. sg., by-form with single -λ- (Ἀχιλεύς)
ἁπάντων: ἅπας — all, the whole of; masc. gen. pl., of comparison after προβέβηκας: ’beyond all’
ἂν: ἀνά — up, aboard; prep./preverb, with apocope ἂν before δ’; in tmesis (ἂν … βήσομεν ’put aboard’) · also modal particle ἄν (= κεν) written ἂν: with the opt., potential: ’would’; with the subj. after εὖτ’: ’whenever’ · also with ὡς + subj.: ’in the way that’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I may say’) · also modal particle with the subj. after ὅτ’: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂν … γένωνται ’whenever they come to be’) · also modal particle with a fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’could’ (οὐκ ἂν … μυθήσομαι ’I could not tell’) · also εἴ περ ἂν + opt., ’even if … should’ · also εἴ περ ἂν + subj., ’even if … ever’ (εἴ περ ἂν αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’even if they set upon him’) · also εἰ … ἂν + subj., ’if ever, should’ (εἰ δ’ ἂν … ἐθέλωσιν ’but if they should be unwilling’) · also with an indic. past tense, contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἂν … ἦεν ’would have been’) · also modal particle ἄν with the subj. after ὄφρα: ’until, while’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … βείω ’until I go’) · also modal particle ἄν after ἐπεί + subj.: ’once’ (ἐπεὶ ἂν … ἐπίσπῃς ’once you have met’)
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’(you) other (gods)’ (Ζεῦ ἄλλοι τε θεοί)
ἄλλον: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. sg.
ἄνακτος: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. gen. sg.
ἄναξ: ἄναξ — lord, master; masc. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. (same form), in address: ’lord!’ (κλῦθι, ἄναξ ’hear me, lord’)
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄρηος: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. gen. sg., epic Ἄρηος (= Attic Ἄρεως) · also by metonymy ’war’ (ἔριδα Ἄρηος ’the strife of war’)
ἄρης: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. nom. sg.
ἄϊδος: Ἅιδης (Ἄϊς) — Hades; masc. gen. sg., epic Ἄϊδος (Attic Ἅιδου)
ἐγένοντο: γίγνομαι — become, be born; aor. 3 pl. mid.: ’were born’ · also ’came to be, got (on one’s way)’ (πρὸ ὁδοῦ ἐγένοντο ’got well on the road’)
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐδείδισαν: δείδω (δείδια) — fear, be afraid; aor. 3 pl., epic -σαν built on the stem δειδ- (= ἔδεισαν): ’they feared’
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνυαλίῳ: Ἐνυάλιος — Enyalius, a name of Ares; masc. dat. sg.
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐξενάριξε: ἐξεναρίζω — slay and strip of arms; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’killed and stripped’
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, at; + dat./acc./gen. · also + acc., ’to, towards’ (βῆ δ’ ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδην ’went to the son of Atreus’) · also + dat., ’to’ (πέμψαι ἐπ’ Ἀτρεΐδῃ ’to send to’) · also preverb in tmesis (ἐπ’ … θήσειν ’to lay upon’) · also + acc. of time, ’until, at’ (ἐπ’ ἠέλιον δῦναι ’until the sun sets’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ἐπ’ ἀλλήλοισιν ἰόντες ’coming against one another’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (ἐπ’ ὠκεανοῖο ῥοάων ’toward the streams of Oceanus’)
ἐπείθετο: πείθω — persuade; mid. ’obey’, + dat.; impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’obeyed’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’)
ἐσθλὸς: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; masc. nom. sg.: ’good’
ἐϋκνήμιδας: ἐϋκνήμις — well-greaved, with good greaves; masc. acc. pl., standing epithet of the Achaeans
ἔασιν: εἰμί — be; epic pres. 3 pl. (= Attic εἰσίν): ’are’
ἔβαλον: βάλλω — throw, cast, put down; aor. 3 pl., augmented: ’they cast out’ · also ’hit, strike’: ’they struck’
ἔθελ: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (ἔθελ’ = ἔθελε)
ἔθελον: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; impf. 1 sg. (same form 3 pl.), unaugmented (= Attic ἤθελον)
ἔθνος: ἔθνος — company, band, throng; neut. acc. sg.
ἔκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; prep. + gen. · also preverb in tmesis (ἔκ … ἐρέω = ἐξερέω ’I shall speak out’)
ἔκειτο: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid up, be stored; impf. 3 sg.
ἔμπεδος: ἔμπεδος — steady, firm, unfailing; adj. of two endings, masc./fem. nom. sg., predicate
ἔνθά: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’)
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’) · also ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’hither and thither, this way and that’
ἔνι: ἐν — in; prep. + dat., postpositive with accent thrown back after its noun (νέεσσ’ ἔνι = Attic ἐν ναυσί)
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔπεφνε: φένω (aor. ἔπεφνον) — slay; aor. 3 sg., epic reduplicated aorist
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔριδος: ἔρις — strife, quarrel, contention; fem. gen. sg.
ἔσσεται: εἰμί — be; fut. 3 sg., epic doubled σ (= Attic ἔσται)
ἔτλη: τλάω — bring oneself to, dare, endure; aor. 3 sg. (ἔτλην, inf. τλῆναι)
ἔφαθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἔφατο, elided ἔφαθ’, τ>θ before rough breathing)
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἕκαστοι: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. pl.: ’each of us’ · also ’each’ of a body of men, in apposition to the whole army (’each company’)
ἕκαστος: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. nom. sg.
ἕκτορι: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. dat. sg.: ’for Hector’
ἕκτορος: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam, chief Trojan hero; masc. gen. sg.
ἕκτωρ: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἕλε: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἷλε)
ἕλον: αἱρέω — take; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic εἷλον); ἐκ … ἕλον in tmesis ’picked out’ · also aor. 1 sg. (same -ον ending): ’I took away’
ἕλοντο: αἱρέω — take; aor. mid. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἵλοντο): ’took (for themselves)’
ἠρήσαντο: ἀράομαι — pray, wish; aor. mid. 3 pl.: ’they prayed’
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’) · also after πρίν, ’before’ (πρίν γ’ ἢ ’before …’) · also in τί ἢ δέ, a form of τίη δέ: ’why then’
ἥρως: ἥρως — hero, man of standing; masc. nom. sg.
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’)
ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic ἦεν (= Attic ἦν)
ἰδομενεὺς: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, king of Crete, leader of the Cretans at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἰδομενῆος: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, Cretan leader; masc. gen. sg., epic -ῆος (= Attic -έως)
ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing, looking’
ἰσόθεος: ἰσόθεος — equal to a god, godlike (ἴσος + θεός); adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἰὼν: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
ἱκάνει: ἱκάνω — come, arrive, reach; pres. 3 sg.
ἱππηλάτα: ἱππηλάτης — horse-driver, charioteer; masc. nom. sg., old form in short -α, epithet of heroes
ἱππότα: ἱππότα — horseman, charioteer (epithet of Nestor); masc. nom. sg., old form in short -α (= ἱππότης)
ἵζευ: ἵζω — sit down, seat oneself; pres. imper. 2 sg. mid., epic ἵζευ (= ἵζου): ’sit down’
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, king of Ithaca; masc. nom. sg.
ὀνειδίζων: ὀνειδίζω — reproach, revile, taunt; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’reviling’
ὁδῷ: ὁδός — road, way; fem. dat. sg.
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’)
ὃν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (masc. acc. sg.)
ὄλεθρον: ὄλεθρος — destruction, ruin, death; masc. acc. sg., object of ἐπήρκεσε
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’)
ὅθ: ὅθι (elided ὅθ’) — where; relative adv. of place · also ὅτε (elided and aspirated ὅθ’) — when; temporal conj.
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὑφ: ὑπό (elided ὑφ’, before a rough breathing) — under; + gen. of agent: ’by, at the hands of’ · also + dat., ’under’ (ὑφ’ ἡμετέρῃσιν ’under our (hands)’)
ὕπερθε: ὕπερθε(ν) — above, from above, on top; adv.
ὕπτιος: ὕπτιος — on one’s back, face up; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ὠκυρόῳ: ὠκύροος — swift-flowing; adj., masc. dat. sg., uncontracted (= Attic ὠκυρῷ)
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’ · also introducing a wish, with ὄφελεν: ’would that’ (ὡς ὄφελεν θάνατός μοι ἁδεῖν ’would that death had pleased me’) · also in a comparison, ’like, just as’ (ὡς ὅδε οἶνος ’like this wine’) · also ὡς εἴ, ’as if’ (ὡς εἴ τι κακὸν ῥέζουσαν ’as if doing some evil’)
ὢ: ὤ — oh! ah! (exclamation, as in ὢ πόποι)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’)
ὤ: ὤ — oh! interjection of distress, esp. in ὤ μοι ’oh me!’
ὤμοισιν: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ὦρτο: ὄρνυμι — stir up, rouse; mid./intr. aor. 3 sg. ὦρτο, root aorist: ’rushed, started up’
ὧδε: ὧδε — in this place, in this way, thus; adv.
ᾧ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative, masc./neut. dat. sg.: ’to whom’ · also possessive, ’his own’
ῥέεθρα: ῥέεθρον — stream, running water, current; neut. acc. pl.
